mechanism: Short-horizon information arriving on Coinbase spot may be incorporated with a measurable delay into an OKX perpetual instrument; a frozen one-minute return differential tests cross-venue transmission without selecting a leader, threshold or holding period from outcomes.

venue_instrument_mapping.quote_difference_policy: features use dimensionless log returns only; no level spread or USD/USDT conversion is used
venue_instrument_mapping.substitution_policy: NONE; an unavailable or non-PIT mapping makes this prereg terminally source-ineligible and requires a new prereg rather than substitution.

timestamp_normalization.bar_definition: exchange-event observations assigned to exact UTC minute [m,m+60s); only fully completed minutes are eligible
timestamp_normalization.synchronization: both venues must have an eligible last price at or before the same minute close and no last-price age greater than 5 seconds
timestamp_normalization.late_data: ignored for that decision; no late seal and no retroactive credit

feature_definition.source_return: ln(Coinbase BTC-USD last_price_at_minute_close / Coinbase BTC-USD last_price_at_previous_minute_close)
feature_definition.execution_return: ln(OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP last_price_at_minute_close / OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP last_price_at_previous_minute_close)
feature_definition.direction_rule: positive scalar defines LONG OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP for the next eligible one-minute holding interval; negative scalar defines SHORT; zero defines FLAT

causal_clock.decision_clock: 5 seconds after each completed UTC minute
causal_clock.lookback: exactly the immediately completed one-minute interval; no rolling optimization or alternate lag
causal_clock.entry: first eligible OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP quote timestamped at or after the decision clock, with maximum 5-second delay
causal_clock.exit: first eligible OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP quote timestamped at or after entry timestamp plus 60 seconds, with maximum 5-second delay
causal_clock.holding_semantics: exactly 60 seconds from eligible entry; no extension, averaging, re-entry or adaptive hold

cost_model.funding_cashflow: include only if an official funding settlement occurs during the frozen 60-second holding interval; otherwise zero
cost_model.source_venue_trade_cost: NONE because Coinbase is information-source-only and no Coinbase order is modeled

evaluation.collection_start: must be later than the merge/freeze timestamp and source-cost admission timestamp
evaluation.dataset_binding: Before the first economics read, bind an immutable manifest containing source endpoint/version metadata, first/last eligible timestamps, record count and SHA-256 hashes of all raw sealed partitions. Any mismatch fails closed.
